name: Verna
description: A 5-seater capacity, modern safety specifications, and multiple fuel or powertrain choice. 1482 cc to 1497 cc petrol options, including high-performance turbo variants. Mileage: Approx. 18.6 to 20.6 kmpl.

name: City
description: A premium 5-seater sedan known for its spacious cabin, refined petrol engine, and excellent build quality. Powered by a 1498 cc petrol engine with smooth CVT or manual gearbox options. Mileage: Approx. 17.8 to 18.4 kmpl.

name: Ciaz
description: A comfortable and fuel-efficient 5-seater sedan ideal for long highway drives. Equipped with a 1462 cc mild-hybrid petrol engine paired with a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. Mileage: Approx. 20.65 kmpl.

name: Safari
description: A powerful 7-seater SUV with a bold design and commanding road presence. Comes with a 1956 cc diesel engine and optional all-wheel drive. Features a panoramic sunroof, ADAS safety suite, and spacious three-row seating. Mileage: Approx. 16.3 to 19.6 kmpl.

name: Seltos
description: A feature-loaded 5-seater mid-size SUV available in petrol, diesel, and strong hybrid variants. 1497 cc to 1999 cc engine options. Offers a large 10.25-inch touchscreen, BOSE audio, and Level 2 ADAS. Mileage: Approx. 16.5 to 18.3 kmpl.

name: Fortuner
description: A full-size 7-seater body-on-frame SUV built for both on-road comfort and off-road capability. Powered by a 2755 cc diesel engine with 4WD option. Known for its legendary reliability and strong resale value. Mileage: Approx. 10.9 to 14.7 kmpl.

name: Swift
description: India's best-selling hatchback with sporty styling, a zippy 1197 cc petrol engine, and excellent fuel economy. Available with manual and AMT gearboxes. Compact dimensions make it ideal for city driving. Mileage: Approx. 24.8 kmpl.

name: i20
description: A premium 5-seater hatchback with a stylish exterior and feature-rich interior including a sunroof and wireless charging. Powered by 1197 cc petrol engines in both naturally aspirated and turbocharged forms. Mileage: Approx. 20.35 to 23.7 kmpl.

name: Nexon EV
description: India's most popular electric SUV with a range of up to 465 km on a full charge. 40.5 kWh battery pack with DC fast charging support. Features connected car technology, automatic climate control, and a premium interior. 0 emissions, zero running fuel cost.

name: ZS EV
description: A 5-seater electric SUV with a 50.3 kWh battery delivering up to 461 km of range. Equipped with a panoramic sunroof, AI-powered voice assistant, and Level 2 ADAS features. Supports fast DC charging up to 76 kW. Zero tailpipe emissions.

name: Urban Cruiser Hyryder
description: A 5-seater compact crossover available in both strong hybrid and mild-hybrid variants. The strong hybrid version delivers class-leading fuel efficiency of approximately 27.97 kmpl with an electric-first drive mode. 1490 cc petrol engine with smooth e-CVT transmission.

name: 3 Series
description: A luxury 5-seater sports sedan with rear-wheel drive dynamics and a refined 1998 cc turbocharged petrol engine producing 258 bhp. Features a 12.3-inch digital cockpit, Harman Kardon audio, and premium leather interior. Mileage: Approx. 14.5 kmpl.

name: X5
description: A full-size luxury 5 to 7-seater SUV with a 2998 cc turbocharged diesel engine producing 340 bhp and all-wheel xDrive. Features a panoramic roof, ambient lighting, semi-autonomous driving, and a premium Bowers & Wilkins audio system. Mileage: Approx. 12.0 kmpl.

name: Altroz
description: A premium 5-seater hatchback with a 5-star Global NCAP safety rating. Available in petrol, diesel, and CNG variants with a 1199 cc or 1497 cc engine. Known for its safe monocoque body, plush ride quality, and well-equipped cabin. Mileage: Approx. 19.0 to 25.1 kmpl.

name: Sonet
description: A compact 5-seater crossover SUV with segment-leading features including a Bose sound system, ventilated seats, and a large 10.25-inch infotainment screen. Available in petrol and diesel with both manual and automatic options. Mileage: Approx. 18.2 to 24.1 kmpl.
